module: common utilities, Redis locks, environment loading and local rate limiting
invariants_checked: UTF-8 truncation boundaries and JSON quote handling
Redis lock ownership tokens, release/renew atomicity, cancellation and bounded release
Environment file precedence and explicit file error propagation
TLS server verification default and explicit override
Redis/local rate budgets, per-key isolation, eviction generation ownership

findings.before: A waiter retained an expired entry while cleanup removed it and a new request installed a live bucket. The waiter unconditionally deleted the live replacement and allowed an over-budget request.
findings.fix: CompareAndDelete only the exact retired entry generation in waiter and cleanup paths.

limitations: Redis protocol behavior tested with miniredis; no production Redis used.
Audit covers these package sources; service integrations are tracked separately.
